name: Camera Shake
description: The camera jolts violently with motion blur and color fringes; the cut happens at the peak of the shake, which settles on the second clip. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: strength
params.description: How far the camera jolts and rolls at the peak

params.name: jolts
params.description: Number of jolts over the transition

params.name: blur
params.description: Length of the motion blur along each jolt

params.name: split
params.description: How far the color channels split apart
